briefs.teaser: This week's AI story was capital: Nvidia lined up $500 billion in financing, Anthropic alone signed over $15 billion in deals, while a KPMG survey found half of firms are already pulling back on AI agents over cost.

AI competition is shifting from model launches to who controls deployment, as ChatGPT passes a billion weekly users, Anthropic lines up a landmark IPO, and a security breach exposes thousands of firms running AI in production.
AI enters its production phase this week: enterprises are running it live, investors are pouring in record sums, and regulators have started enforcing their first binding rules.
